add_mask_rcnn_blobs: add Mask R-CNN specific blobs including mask targets and ROI data to the input blob dictionary for training
expand_class_specific_masks: expand mask targets from per-mask shape to class-specific shape encoding for multi-class Mask R-CNN training
prepare_mask_targets: prepare binary mask targets by rasterizing polygon ground truth masks to M x M resolution for foreground ROIs
compute_bbox_overlaps: compute bounding box overlaps between foreground ROIs and segmentation polygon boxes to find best mask matches
handle_empty_fg_masks: handle edge case of no foreground masks by creating a dummy background ROI with ignore labels for the network
